summary: A mixed legal and retail day, led by a Punjab & Haryana High Court rebuke of GST authorities for manipulating records and ignoring court orders, alongside strong Reliance fundraising and retail sector momentum from Tata Cliq's narrowing losses.

bullets.text: Punjab & Haryana HC rapped GST authorities for manipulating records and arresting trader despite court orders.
Tata Cliq narrowed net loss 19% to Rs 253 cr in FY26; revenue rose 20% to Rs 354 cr.
Reliance Industries plans up to $1 billion local currency bond sale, second fundraise in three weeks.
Anmol Industries biscuit maker files for $188 million IPO at up to 18 billion rupees valuation.
Supreme Court refuses to halt forensic audit of Fortis transactions in Daiichi-Singh brothers dispute.
